BNS 178 Explanation (3) and (4) carry the IPC 255 and IPC 231 Explanations. BNS 178 also absorbs IPC 489A, which is outside the 230-300 range.

IPC 233 (p62): "Making or selling instrument for counterfeiting coin.—Whoever makes or mends, or performs any part of the process of making or mending, or buys, sells or disposes of, any die or instrument"; IPC 234/235 (p62) and IPC 256/257 (p64) are the matching instrument offences for Indian coin, coin possession and Government stamps. I matched IPC 234, 235, 256 and 257 to BNS 181 using their IPC headings on p7 and their opening lines on p62/p64. I did not read their full bodies.
